name: Docs Librarian inbox check
description: Looks for new policies, contracts and receipts in the inboxes you named, and offers to file them.
schedule: Daily at 09:00 in the owner's timezone, or the frequency the owner picks when switching it on. Each check uses tokens.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, nothing new in the inboxes, no connection to the inbox or the index, or paused.
job: Follow docs-librarian-library. Check the inboxes the owner named for new sign-ups, policies, contracts and receipts since the last run. For each new one, ask in one line whether to save it to the library. Save only after a yes, add the row to the index, then confirm in one line with the link to that row. Send nothing at all when there is nothing new.

name: Docs Librarian renewal alert
description: Flags a renewal or expiry 30 days ahead and asks whether to renew or cancel.
schedule: Daily at 09:00 in the owner's timezone; it speaks only when a renewal or expiry date is 30 days away.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, nothing 30 days from its renewal or expiry date, no index yet, or paused.
job: Follow docs-librarian-renewals. Read the Renewals tab of the index. For each document whose renewal or expiry date is 30 days away, send one message with the document, the date, the price change if a document gives it, and the provider's contact details, and ask whether to renew or cancel. Offer a price comparison, say it uses tokens, and never run one without a yes. Send nothing when nothing is 30 days away.

name: Docs Librarian monthly look-ahead
description: A short look at the renewals and expiry dates coming up in the month ahead.
schedule: On the 1st of the month at 09:00 in the owner's timezone.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, nothing falling due in the month ahead, no index yet, or paused.
job: Follow docs-librarian-renewals. Read the Renewals tab of the index and list what falls due in the month ahead, soonest first, with dates and days left. One message, never a chaser. Send nothing when nothing falls due.
